Frequently asked questions

How does Verkflo decide which branch a run takes?

Rules written in CEL choose the branch, so the same input takes the same path. The model reads documents and drafts notes for the run.

When does a run pause for a person?

Where your procedure says a person decides. The run stops at that step, asks a named reviewer, and carries on from the decision, which is logged.

What does the audit log record, and how is it verified?

Every action in a run is written to the log, and each entry carries the hash of the one before it. You can verify the chain at any time, and an entry that was changed is flagged.

How are API keys and secrets handled?

Secrets live in a vault. Each step holds a reference to the vault path, so the key itself is never pasted into a step.

Can we test a version before it goes live?

Yes. New versions run on test data in the sandbox first, and evals check your scenarios. A failing scenario blocks publishing until it is fixed. Going live is a separate step.

Who can change a procedure?

Access is by role: Admin, Author, Reviewer and Auditor, scoped to each workspace.

How are inbound webhooks secured?

A webhook trigger checks the signature and freshness of each delivery. Unsigned or stale deliveries are rejected before a run starts.

Do you hold security certifications?

Not yet. Ask us about our current security practices during a demo.
